question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Garrulous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Reserved.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Garrulous" means excessively talkative, especially about trivial matters. (बातूनी)

 

• "Reserved" means slow to reveal thoughts or feelings; quietly restrained. It is therefore the correct antonym. (संकोची)

◦ Example: He remained reserved throughout the meeting, offering only brief comments when directly asked.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Loquacious (बहुवाचाल) — tending to talk a great deal; a synonym of garrulous.

• Option 2: Chatty (गपशप करने वाला) — fond of casual, friendly conversation; a synonym of garrulous.

• Option 3: Talkative (बातूनी) — fond of talking a great deal; a synonym of garrulous.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of garrulous: Quiet, Taciturn, Reticent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Prosperity (समृद्धि): Poverty (गरीबी), Failure (असफलता)

2. Prudent (समझदार): Thoughtless (अविवेकी), Careless (लापरवाह)

3. Puissant (शक्तिशाली): Feeble (कमजोर), Weak (दुर्बल)

4. Pulchritude (सुंदरता): Ugliness (कुरूपता), Plainness (साधारणता)

5. Pulverize (चूर्ण करना): Restore (पुनः स्थापित करना), Repair (मरम्मत करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Opprobrium".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Honor.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Opprobrium" means harsh criticism or public disgrace resulting from shameful conduct. (निंदा)

◦ Example: The corrupt official faced widespread opprobrium after the scandal was exposed by journalists.

 

• "Honor" means high respect or public esteem, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सम्मान)

◦ Example: The soldier received great honor for his courageous actions during the rescue mission.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Infamy (कुख्याति): the state of being well known for a bad quality — a synonym of opprobrium, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Disgrace (अपमान): public shame or loss of respect — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Reproach (तिरस्कार): expression of disapproval or disappointment — close in sense to opprobrium.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of opprobrium: disgrace, infamy, reproach, censure, condemnation.

• Synonyms of honor: respect, esteem, reverence, distinction, prestige.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Purify (शुद्ध करना): Pollute (प्रदूषित करना), Contaminate (दूषित करना)

2. Purportedly (कथित रूप से): Impossibly (असंभव रूप से)

3. Pusillanimous (कायर): Brave (साहसी), Courageous (वीर)

4. Quaint (अनोखा / प्यारा): Ordinary (सामान्य), Common (साधारण)

5. Quell (दबाना): Provoke (भड़काना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Erudite".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Uninformed.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Erudite" means having or showing great knowledge gained through extensive study. (विद्वान)

◦ Example: The erudite historian delivered a lecture so rich in detail that even seasoned scholars took careful notes.

 

• "Uninformed" means lacking knowledge or accurate information about a subject, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अज्ञानी)

◦ Example: Voters who remain uninformed about candidates' policies often make decisions based on advertisements rather than facts.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Scholarly (विद्वत्तापूर्ण): relating to serious academic study — a synonym of erudite, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Knowledgeable (जानकार): well informed about many subjects — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Learned (विद्वान): having extensive knowledge from study — close in sense to erudite.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of erudite: Learned, Scholarly, Knowledgeable, Cultured, Intellectual.

• Synonyms of uninformed: Ignorant, Unaware, Uneducated, Unschooled, Clueless.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quixotic (अव्यावहारिक): Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी)

2. Rampart (किले की दीवार): Ditch (खाई), Opening (खुला स्थान)

3. Random (अनियमित): Systematic (सुव्यवस्थित), Planned (योजनाबद्ध)

4. Ravaged (विनष्ट): Restored (पुनःस्थापित)

5. Rebarbative (अप्रिय / अरुचिकर): Attractive (आकर्षक), Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Monstrous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Beautiful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Monstrous" means extremely ugly or frightening, or unnaturally huge. (भयानक / विशाल)

 

• "Beautiful" means pleasing to the senses or mind aesthetically. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सुंदर)

◦ Example: The garden was beautiful in spring, with rows of tulips blooming beneath the cherry trees.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Grotesque (विकृत) — distorted and unnatural in appearance; a synonym of monstrous.

• Option 3: Hideous (घिनौना) — extremely ugly or repulsive; a synonym of monstrous.

• Option 4: Horrific (भयावह) — causing horror or shock; a synonym of monstrous.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of monstrous: Lovely, Gentle, Gorgeous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Rebellion (विद्रोह): Loyalty (निष्ठा)

2. Recalcitrance (अवज्ञा): Compliance (आज्ञापालन), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता)

3. Receive (प्राप्त करना): Give (देना), Send (भेजना)

4. Recount (बयान करना): Suppress (दबाना), Conceal (छिपाना)

5. Rectify (सुधारना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Damage (हानि करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Veracity".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Falsehood.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Veracity" means the quality of being true, honest, or accurate. (सत्यता)

◦ Example: The court questioned several witnesses to determine the veracity of the defendant's alibi.

 

• "Falsehood" means something that is not true; a false statement or belief, and is therefore the correct antonym. (असत्य)

◦ Example: Rumors spreading through the office turned out to be nothing more than a baseless falsehood.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Authenticity (प्रामाणिकता): the quality of being genuine and true — a synonym of veracity, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Genuineness (वास्तविकता): the quality of being real, not fake — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Exactness (यथार्थता): strict precision or correctness — close in sense to veracity.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of veracity: Authenticity, Genuineness, Exactness, Truth, Correctness.

• Synonyms of falsehood: Lie, Untruth, Deception, Fabrication, Fiction.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Redeem (सुधारना): Forfeit (गंवाना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना)

2. Redolent (सुगंधित): Unscented (बिना गंध), Odorless (गंधहीन)

3. Refulgent (चमकदार): Dull (फीका), Dim (मंद)

4. Refuse (मना करना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Permit (अनुमति देना)

5. Relevant (प्रासंगिक): Inappropriate (अनुचित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Eager."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Indifferent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Eager" means having keen interest or strong desire to do something. (उत्सुक)

 

• "Indifferent" means having no particular interest or concern; apathetic. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदासीन)

◦ Example: He remained indifferent to the outcome of the match, showing no emotion either way.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Zealous (जोशीला) — filled with great energy for a cause; a synonym of eager.

• Option 3: Enthusiastic (उत्साही) — showing intense enjoyment or interest; a synonym of eager.

• Option 4: Avid (अति उत्सुक) — having a keen interest in something; a synonym of eager.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of eager: Uninterested, Apathetic, Unconcerned.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Relinquish (त्यागना): Retain (रखना), Continue (जारी रखना)

2. Reluctant (अनिच्छुक): Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Willing (तैयार)

3. Reprobate (अनैतिक व्यक्ति): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Moral (नैतिक)

4. Repudiate (त्यागना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना)

5. Repulsive (घृणित): Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Suppress".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Incite.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Suppress" means to forcibly put an end to or prevent something. (दबाना)

◦ Example: The government used military force to suppress the growing rebellion in the northern provinces.

 

• "Incite" means to encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behavior, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उकसाना)

◦ Example: The rebel leader was accused of trying to incite violence among the protesting workers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Curb (नियंत्रित करना): to restrain or hold back something — a synonym of suppress, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Quell (दबाना): to put an end to something forcefully — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Stifle (दबा देना): to prevent something from developing — close in sense to suppress.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of suppress: Quell, Curb, Stifle, Repress, Crush.

• Synonyms of incite: Provoke, Instigate, Stir, Foment, Rouse.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Resilient (मजबूत): Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर)

2. Retired (सेवानिवृत्त): Active (सक्रिय), Working (कार्यरत)

3. Reverence (सम्मान): Contempt (तिरस्कार), Scorn (घृणा)

4. Risible (हंसने योग्य): Serious (गंभीर), Grave (गंभीर)

5. Rowdy (उपद्रवी): Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Calm (शांत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Affirmative".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Negative.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Affirmative" means expressing agreement, consent, or a positive response. (सकारात्मक)

◦ Example: The committee gave an affirmative response, approving the proposal without any further amendments.

 

• "Negative" means expressing denial, disagreement, or refusal, and is therefore the correct antonym. (नकारात्मक)

◦ Example: The panel gave a negative verdict, rejecting the proposed merger on antitrust grounds.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Confirmatory (पुष्टिकारक): serving to confirm something — a synonym of affirmative, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Assenting (सहमतिपूर्ण): expressing agreement or approval — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Positive (सकारात्मक): expressing agreement or approval — close in sense to affirmative.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of affirmative: Positive, Confirmatory, Assenting, Agreeing, Favorable.

• Synonyms of negative: Denying, Dissenting, Contrary, Opposing, Disapproving.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ruthless (निर्दयी): Compassionate (दयालु), Kind (कृपालु)

2. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (अविवेकी)

3. Sanguine (आशावादी): Melancholic (निराश), Pessimistic (निराशावादी)

4. Scared (डरा हुआ): Brave (साहसी), Fearless (निर्भय)

5. Scary (डरावना): Comforting (सांत्वनादायक), Reassuring (आश्वस्त करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Receive."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Give.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Receive" means to take, acquire, or come into possession of something. (प्राप्त करना)

 

• "Give" means to freely transfer possession of something to someone. It is therefore the correct antonym. (देना)

◦ Example: Volunteers give their time and energy every weekend to help clean up the local park.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Accept (स्वीकार करना) — to receive something willingly; a synonym of receive.

• Option 2: Obtain (हासिल करना) — to get or acquire something; a synonym of receive.

• Option 4: Acquire (अर्जित करना) — to gain possession of something; a synonym of receive.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of receive: Send, Donate, Grant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Scattered (बिखरा): Gathered (इकट्ठा), Collected (संग्रहित)

2. Scrupulous (ईमानदार / नैतिक): Immoral (अनैतिक), Dishonest (बेईमान)

3. Searing (जलाना/तेज़ गर्म): Freezing (जमाने वाला/ठंडा), Cold (ठंडा)

4. Secure (सुरक्षित): Insecure (असुरक्षित), Unsafe (असुरक्षित)

5. Seldom (कभी-कभी): Frequently (अक्सर), Often (बार-बार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Exiguous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Plentiful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Exiguous" means extremely scanty or meager in amount. (कम)

 

• "Plentiful" means existing in large quantities; abundant. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रचुर)

◦ Example: The farmers enjoyed a plentiful harvest this year thanks to favorable weather and improved irrigation techniques.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Sparse (विरल) — thinly scattered or distributed; a synonym of exiguous.

• Option 2: Meager (अल्प) — lacking in quantity or quality; a synonym of exiguous.

• Option 4: Scanty (अत्यल्प) — insufficient in amount; a synonym of exiguous.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of exiguous: Abundant, Ample, Copious.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Selective (चयनशील): Careless (लापरवाह), Indiscriminate (भेदभाव रहित)

2. Sell (बेचना): Buy (खरीदना), Purchase (खरीदना)

3. Serene (शांत): Chaotic (अशांत), Turbulent (उथल-पुथल)

4. Servile (चापलूस): Arrogant (घमंडी), Independent (स्वतंत्र)

5. Shallow (उथला): Deep (गहरा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ephemeral."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Eternal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Ephemeral" means lasting for a very short time; short-lived. (क्षणभंगुर)

 

• "Eternal" means lasting or existing forever; without beginning or end. It is therefore the correct antonym. (शाश्वत)

◦ Example: The ancient temple was built to symbolize eternal devotion to the deity it honored.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Fleeting (अल्पकालिक) — passing quickly; a synonym of ephemeral.

• Option 3: Momentary (पल भर का) — lasting only a moment; a synonym of ephemeral.

• Option 4: Transient (क्षणिक) — lasting only a short time; a synonym of ephemeral.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of ephemeral: Permanent, Everlasting, Perpetual.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Shrink (सिकुड़ना): Expand (फैलना), Grow (बढ़ना)

2. Slander (बदनाम करना): Praise (प्रशंसा), Appreciate (सराहना)

3. Slender (पतला): Stout (मोटा), Thick (मोटा)

4. Sloppy (मैला/लापरवाह): Dashing (सजावटी/स्मार्ट), Neat (साफ-सुथरा)

5. Sluggish (सुस्त): Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Casual".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Formal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Casual" means relaxed and informal in manner or dress. (अनौपचारिक)

◦ Example: Employees are allowed to wear casual clothing on Fridays instead of the usual business attire.

 

• "Formal" means following established conventions or rules; official, and is therefore the correct antonym. (औपचारिक)

◦ Example: The ambassador wore formal attire to the state banquet hosted by the visiting dignitaries.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Relaxed (सहज): free from tension or anxiety — a synonym of casual, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Informal (अनौपचारिक): not formal or official — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Nonchalant (बेपरवाह): calmly indifferent or unconcerned — close in sense to casual.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of casual: informal, relaxed, offhand, easygoing, nonchalant.

• Synonyms of formal: official, ceremonial, conventional, proper, structured.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sneer (उपहास करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Respect (सम्मान करना)

2. Solicit (मदद माँगना): Prohibit (मना करना), Forbid (प्रतिबंध लगाना)

3. Somnolent (निद्रालु): Awake (जाग्रत), Alert (सतर्क)

4. Sophisticated (उन्नत): Primitive (आदिम), Simple (सरल)

5. Soporific (नींद लाने वाला): Stimulating (उत्तेजक), Energizing (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Allay."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Aggravate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Allay" means to make fear, doubt, or worry less intense; to calm. (शांत करना)

 

• "Aggravate" means to make a problem, injury, or situation worse. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बढ़ाना)

◦ Example: Ignoring the wound's infection only served to aggravate the patient's already serious condition.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Alleviate (कम करना) — to make suffering or a problem less severe; a synonym of allay.

• Option 2: Soothe (शांत करना) — to gently calm a person or feeling; a synonym of allay.

• Option 4: Assuage (शांत करना) — to make an unpleasant feeling less intense; a synonym of allay.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of allay: Worsen, Intensify.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sporadic (अनियमित): Frequent (बार-बार), Regular (नियमित)

2. Spurious (नकली): Authentic (असली), Genuine (वास्तविक)

3. Squirm (घबराना/बेचैन होना): Relax (आराम करना), Calm (शांत रहना)

4. Stale (बासी): Fresh (ताज़ा), New (नया)

5. Staunch (दृढ़): Unsteady (अस्थिर), Weak (कमज़ोर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Amateur."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Expert.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Amateur" means a person who does something without professional training or pay. (शौकिया)

 

• "Expert" means a person with comprehensive and authoritative knowledge or skill. It is therefore the correct antonym. (विशेषज्ञ)

◦ Example: The museum hired an expert to authenticate the painting before the upcoming auction.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Dilettante (शौकिया) — a person with only superficial interest in a subject; a synonym of amateur.

• Option 3: Novice (नौसिखिया) — a person new to a skill or activity; a synonym of amateur.

• Option 4: Beginner (शुरुआती) — a person just starting to learn something; a synonym of amateur.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of amateur: Professional, Specialist.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Strange (अजीब): Mundane (साधारण), Familiar (परिचित)

2. Strenuous (कठिन/जोरदार): Easy (आसान), Effortless (सरल)

3. Strong (मजबूत): Weak (कमजोर), Fragile (नाजुक)

4. Stunning (आश्चर्यजनक): Mundane (साधारण), Ordinary (सामान्य)

5. Sublime (उत्कृष्ट): Mediocre (साधारण), Inferior (निम्न)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Mythical".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Verifiable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Mythical" means existing only in myth or legend; imaginary. (काल्पनिक)

◦ Example: The dragon remains a mythical creature, appearing in the folklore of nearly every ancient culture.

 

• "Verifiable" means able to be checked or proved to be true, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सत्यापित)

◦ Example: Scientists insisted the claim was worthless unless supported by verifiable data from repeated experiments.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Legendary (पौराणिक): described in legend rather than fact — a synonym of mythical, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Fabled (कथित): described in fables; famous but unreal — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Fictitious (काल्पनिक): invented rather than real — close in sense to mythical.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of mythical: Legendary, Fictitious, Imaginary, Fabled, Fantastical.

• Synonyms of verifiable: Real, Factual, Genuine, Authentic.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Subterfuge (छल): Candor (स्पष्टवादिता), Honesty (ईमानदारी)

2. Success (सफलता): Failure (असफलता), Defeat (पराजय)

3. Superficial (सतही): Profound (गहरा), Deep (गंभीर)

4. Superfluous (अनावश्यक / फालतू): Essential (आवश्यक), Necessary (जरूरी)

5. Suppress (दबाना): Incite (उकसाना), Reveal (प्रकट करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Undesirable."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Advisable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Undesirable" means not wanted or attractive; harmful or objectionable. (अवांछनीय)

 

• "Advisable" means to be recommended as sensible or prudent; wise. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उचित)

◦ Example: It is advisable to carry an umbrella whenever the forecast predicts heavy afternoon rainfall.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Objectionable (आपत्तिजनक) — causing disapproval or opposition; a synonym of undesirable.

• Option 2: Unpleasant (अप्रिय) — not enjoyable or agreeable; disagreeable; a synonym of undesirable.

• Option 3: Unwanted (अवांछित) — not desired or welcome; a synonym of undesirable.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of undesirable: Suitable, Sensible, Recommended.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Surreptitious (गुप्त): Overt (खुला), Open (स्पष्ट)

2. Sustainability (स्थिरता): Indefensibility (अस्थिरता/असुरक्षित स्थिति)

3. Sustenance (जीविका): Starvation (भूखमरी), Deprivation (वंचना)

4. Sweet (मीठा): Bitter (कड़वा), Sour (खट्टा)

5. Synthetic (कृत्रिम): Natural (प्राकृतिक), Genuine (वास्तविक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Calm".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Agitate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Calm" means not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotion. (शांत)

◦ Example: The sea remained calm throughout the morning, allowing the fishermen to sail out safely without any trouble.

 

• "Agitate" means make someone troubled or nervous; disturb them, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उत्तेजित)

◦ Example: The unexpected announcement began to agitate the crowd, causing many people to shout and demand answers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Tranquil (शांत): free from disturbance; calm — a synonym of calm, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण): free from disturbance; tranquil — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Serene (प्रशांत): calm, peaceful, and untroubled — close in sense to calm.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of calm: peaceful, tranquil, serene, placid, composed.

• Synonyms of agitate: disturb, upset, unsettle, provoke, stir.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Taboo (वर्जित): Acceptable (स्वीकृत)

2. Tacit (अव्यक्त): Explicit (स्पष्ट), Expressed (प्रकट)

3. Taciturn (कम बोलने वाला): Talkative (बातूनी), Verbose (अधिक बोलने वाला)

4. Tangible (मूर्त): Intangible (अमूर्त), Abstract (अव्यक्त)

5. Tardy (सुस्त/देरी से): Prompt (समय पर), Quick (तेज)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Sophisticated".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Primitive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Sophisticated" means highly developed, complex, or refined in design. (उन्नत)

◦ Example: The company developed a sophisticated algorithm to detect fraudulent transactions in real time.

 

• "Primitive" means relating to an early, simple, or undeveloped stage, and is therefore the correct antonym. (आदिम)

◦ Example: The remote tribe still uses primitive tools made of stone and wood for hunting.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Refined (परिष्कृत): elegant and cultured in style — a synonym of sophisticated, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Complex (जटिल): made of many interconnected parts — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Advanced (उन्नत): far ahead in development or progress — close in sense to sophisticated.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of sophisticated: Advanced, Refined, Complex, Elaborate, Cultured.

• Synonyms of primitive: Crude, Basic, Undeveloped, Rudimentary, Archaic.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tedious (उबाऊ / थकाऊ): Exciting (रोचक), Engaging (आकर्षक)

2. Tenacious (जिद्दी / दृढ़): Yielding (झुकने वाला), Weak (कमजोर)

3. Tenebrous (अंधकारमय): Bright (उज्ज्वल), Clear (स्पष्ट)

4. Thwart (विफल करना): Assist (सहायता करना), Help (मदद करना)

5. Timid (डरपोक): Daring (साहसी), Bold (निडर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Chivalrous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Cowardly.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Chivalrous" means courteous and honorable, especially toward women. (उदार)

 

• "Cowardly" means lacking courage; showing fear in a shameful way. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कायर)

◦ Example: The soldier's cowardly retreat during the battle disappointed his fellow officers deeply.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Gallant (शूरवीर) — brave and courteous, especially to women; a synonym of chivalrous.

• Option 3: Gentlemanly (सज्जनतापूर्ण) — polite and honorable in manner; a synonym of chivalrous.

• Option 4: Courteous (विनम्र) — polite and considerate; a synonym of chivalrous.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of chivalrous: Defiant, Rude, Discourteous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Torpor (सुस्ती): Liveliness (सजीवता), Activity (सक्रियता)

2. Traditional (परम्परागत): Modern (आधुनिक), Unusual (असामान्य)

3. Traitor (देशद्रोही): Loyal (वफादार), Patriot (देशभक्त)

4. Transient (क्षणिक): Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (दीर्घकालिक)

5. Transitory (अस्थायी): Eternal (स्थायी), Permanent (स्थायी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Cursory".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Thorough.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Cursory" means hasty and superficial, done without attention to detail. (सरसरी / सतही)

◦ Example: A cursory glance at the report was not enough for the auditor to detect the hidden accounting discrepancies.

 

• "Thorough" means complete and careful, attending to every detail, and is therefore the correct antonym. (गहराई से)

◦ Example: The inspector conducted a thorough examination of the building before certifying it safe for public occupation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Superficial (सतही): concerned only with the obvious — a synonym of cursory, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Hasty (जल्दबाज़): done with excessive speed — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Perfunctory (औपचारिक): carried out with minimal effort — close in sense to cursory.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of cursory: hasty, superficial, perfunctory, hurried, brief.

• Synonyms of thorough: detailed, meticulous, comprehensive, careful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Trepidation (घबराहट): Calm (शांत), Relaxed (आरामदायक)

2. Triumph (विजय): Defeat (पराजय), Failure (असफलता)

3. Triumphant (विजयी): Defeated (पराजित), Unsuccessful (असफल)

4. Trivial (तुच्छ): Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Significant (जरूरी)

5. Truculent (लड़ाकू): Amiable (मिलनसार), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Established."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Displaced.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Established" means recognized, accepted, or set up on a firm or permanent basis. (स्थापित)

 

• "Displaced" means forced to leave one's home or position, often due to conflict. It is therefore the correct antonym. (विस्थापित)

◦ Example: Thousands of displaced families sought shelter in temporary camps after the devastating earthquake struck the region.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Settled (बसा हुआ) — firmly placed or fixed in position; a synonym of established.

• Option 2: Entrenched (जड़ जमाया हुआ) — firmly established and hard to change; a synonym of established.

• Option 3: Founded (स्थापित) — set up or brought into being; a synonym of established.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of established: Uprooted, Dislodged, Unsettled.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tumult (शोर-शराबा): Calmness (शांति), Silence (मौन)

2. Turbulent (अशांत): Calm (शांत), Peaceful (सुकून भरा)

3. Turpitude (अनैतिकता): Morality (नैतिकता), Virtue (सदाचार)

4. Uncomfortable (असुविधाजनक): Comfortable (आरामदायक), Easy (सहज)

5. Undesirable (अवांछनीय): Advisable (उचित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Fallacy."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Truth.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Fallacy" means a mistaken belief based on unsound reasoning. (गलत धारणा)

 

• "Truth" means the quality of being in accordance with fact or reality. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सत्य)

◦ Example: Scientists spent years of careful research to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disease outbreak.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Myth (मिथक) — a widely held but false belief; a synonym of fallacy.

• Option 2: Misconception (गलतफहमी) — a view or opinion that is incorrect; a synonym of fallacy.

• Option 3: Delusion (भ्रम) — a false belief held despite evidence; a synonym of fallacy.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of fallacy: Fact, Reality, Certainty.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Unprecedented (अभूतपूर्व): Familiar (परिचित)

2. Unsure (अनिश्चित): Certain (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का)

3. Upright (ईमानदार): Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Dishonest (बेईमान)

4. Usurp (हड़पना): Restore (वापस करना), Surrender (समर्पण करना)

5. Utterly (पूरी तरह): Minimally (न्यूनतम), Slightly (थोड़ा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Futile."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Effective.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Futile" means producing no useful result; pointless or worthless. (व्यर्थ)

 

• "Effective" means producing the intended result successfully; efficient. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रभावी)

◦ Example: The new vaccine proved highly effective in preventing the spread of the disease.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Pointless (निरर्थक) — having no purpose or meaning; a synonym of futile.

• Option 3: Useless (बेकार) — not achieving anything useful; a synonym of futile.

• Option 4: Fruitless (निष्फल) — failing to achieve the desired result; a synonym of futile.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of futile: Useful, Productive, Successful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vacillate (डगमगाना): Decide (निर्णय लेना), Resolve (निश्चित करना)

2. Vain (घमंडी/अहंकारी): Humble (नम्र), Modest (विनम्र)

3. Vehement (तीव्र/जोरदार): Mild (मंद), Gentle (कोमल)

4. Venerable (आदरणीय): Immature (अपरिपक्व), Disrespectful (अनादरपूर्ण)

5. Venerate (सम्मान करना): Despise (घृणा करना), Disrespect (अनादर करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Adventurous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Cautious.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Adventurous" means willing to take risks or try new, exciting experiences. (साहसी)

 

• "Cautious" means careful to avoid potential problems or dangers. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सावधान)

◦ Example: The cautious investor preferred stable government bonds over volatile technology stocks throughout the recession.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Enterprising (उद्यमशील) — having initiative to undertake new projects; a synonym of adventurous.

• Option 2: Audacious (दुस्साहसी) — extremely bold, sometimes recklessly so; a synonym of adventurous.

• Option 4: Daring (साहसी) — willing to take risks; bold; a synonym of adventurous.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of adventurous: Careful, Wary.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Venom (जहर): Benevolent (दयालुता), Antidote (विषनाशक)

2. Veracity (सत्यता): Falsehood (असत्य), Dishonesty (बेईमानी)

3. Veracity (सत्यता): Falsehood (असत्य), Lie (झूठ)

4. Veteran (अनुभवी): Novice (नवसिखुआ), Beginner (शुरुआती)

5. Vexatious (कष्टदायक / तंग करने वाला): Pleasant (सुखद), Comforting (आरामदायक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Compelled."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Demur.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Compelled" means forced or obliged to do something. (मजबूर)

 

• "Demur" means raise objections or show reluctance to do something. It is therefore the correct antonym. (आपत्ति करना)

◦ Example: Several board members demurred when asked to approve the risky investment proposal.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Coerced (बाध्य किया गया) — persuaded forcibly to do something; a synonym of compelled.

• Option 3: Forced (मजबूर) — made to do something against one's will; a synonym of compelled.

• Option 4: Obliged (बाध्य) — required to do something; a synonym of compelled.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of compelled: Free, Voluntary, Willing.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vigilant (सतर्क): Negligent (लापरवाह)

2. Vilify (बदनाम करना): Commend (प्रशंसा करना), Praise (सराहना)

3. Vindicate (निर्दोष साबित करना): Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Blame (दोष देना)

4. Violent (हिंसक): Gentle (कोमल), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण)

5. Vivacious (चंचल): Dull (नीरस), Lifeless (निष्प्राण)
